text:
Ivy: Hey team — Ivy here, starting as a product designer this morning. Quick unblock: Figma invite shows "request access" and I can't find the 'Feature Briefs' folder in Notion. Also hunting for interview script templates and the consent blurb. Who should I ping?

Product Onboarding Bot: welcome Ivy :tada: Invite sent to ivy@redwood.ai. Roadmap & Feature Briefs: Notion > Product > Feature Briefs (https://redwood-internal.notion.site/Product-Feature-Briefs). Research templates: Notion > Product > Research > Templates. If figma stuck try `/resend_invite figma ivy@redwood.ai` or reply 'manual add'.

Ivy: tried resend, still on request screen in Brave.

Kai: hey Ivy  welcome! DM'd — i'll manually add you to the "Product Design" team in Figma. Quick question: do you need access to the System files repo (tokens + components) or just project files?

Ivy: system files would be great — i'll be working on the header redesign.

Design Ops: manual add complete  Ivy was added to Figma team "Product Design" and given contributor access to "Redwood UI Library". If you still see request page clear cookies or open https://www.figma.com/files/recent.

Ivy: i can open it now, thanks! found "Redwood UI Library". small process q: where are past usability scripts and the standard consent wording?

PM-Lead: welcome Ivy. Usability scripts and consent language are in Notion: Product > Research > Playbooks > Usability (consent template at the top). For recordings/transcripts we use S3 and link them on the study page. If you need S3 access request via SSO -> AWS -> Request `research-read` and ping @Design Ops.

Ivy: perfect. one more: is there a short handoff checklist PMs expect for design deliverables?

Kai: handoff checklist is on the PRD template: Prototype link, Acceptance criteria, Tokens used, Test cases, and a short screenshot + reproduction steps. We usually paste the checklist at the top of the PRD under "Design Handoff".

Ivy: great — can someone add me to the weekly design critique and research sync?

Design Ops: added you to Design Critique (Wednesdays 4pm) and Research Sync (Thurs 9am). Also ping me if you want the interview script archive zipped.

Ivy: thanks everyone! i'll join the 4pm critique and will take a look at the playbooks before then :smile:
